visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a white T-shirt faces the camera, speaking into a silver Shure microphone. He holds a blue and white product box for a 'CyberDock' 3-in-1 charger. The setting is indoors with bright natural light from a window behind him. (2) The scene transitions to the man holding the unboxed device, which is a silver, low-poly model car resembling a Cybertruck. He rotates the object to show its plastic texture and design. He then displays two spare black wheels and a white charging cable held between his fingers. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the side of the car-shaped charger placed on an orange surface. A hand plugs a black USB-C cable into the port. A thin white LED light strip at the front of the vehicle illuminates upon connection. (4) The camera shows the man pressing a button on the car's side, causing a small square platform to pop out for an Apple Watch. He places a purple iPhone onto the slanted front surface where a MagSafe ring is visible. (5) The iPhone is shown rotating from portrait to landscape orientation automatically on the charger. The man adds a pair of AirPods to the back 'bed' of the car, demonstrating simultaneous charging of three devices. (6) A final shot shows a QR code overlay on a black background with Chinese text, concluding the demonstration.
